name: squiggly-text
blurb: Text underline squiggles with a wavy animated effect.
description: An underline beneath text that waves or squiggles with a smooth animation, creating a hand-drawn feel.
use_when: Friendly or playful headings, emphasis marks.
avoid_when: Professional or formal contexts — squiggles feel casual.
a11y: Purely decorative underline. Text is readable.
